prompts.marlo: Use case: identity-preserve. Gameplay sprite atlas for Mermaid Roshan. Reference image is the approved Marlo river otter identity, warm dark-brown fur, cream muzzle/chest, friendly rounded face and small ears. Preserve this exact polished hand-painted 2D storybook character, anatomy and colors. Missing action only: make one transparent 2 by 2 sprite sheet of four sequential WHOLE-BODY swimming-paddle poses, facing right, horizontal and buoyant, limbs alternately swept and tucked naturally while swimming through water. Four cells all same size and character scale and same torso center/pivot. Tail extends left and flows with the body. Clearly swimming through water, not standing, walking or sitting, no floor, no splash or water pixels, no tethers, bubbles, objects, text, labels, grid lines or shadows. Each complete otter fully inside own cell with generous transparent margin. Strong but soft dark-brown contours, painted grouped highlights, children's book finish. A small coherent loop with beginning and end close in pose, visible paws and tail propulsion. This is the existing otter performing an authorized new action. Output actual RGBA transparency, square overall sheet.
prompts.bubble: One finished gameplay bubble for Mermaid Roshan. Reference image is appearance and palette context only, replace the clustered draft with a SINGLE clean circular translucent bubble centered on a genuinely transparent RGBA square canvas, occupying 78 percent of the canvas. Polished painted 2D storybook style, smooth plum-indigo outer contour, 2 to 4 pixels at a 70-pixel runtime bubble, one broad ivory upper-left reflection, one subtle lower-right cool glint. Broad soft pearly transparent bands around the rim, very faint neutral interior with alpha around 0.2 so the scene shows through. Neutral pale grey and white so color tinting works. No speckles, chips, jagged white edge, clusters, sparkles, text, prop, scene, floor, cast shadow or checkerboard. Precisely smooth circle with a tiny painted kelp attachment knot at bottom. The bubble must read cleanly on bright turquoise water.
prompts.items: Create ONE production item-icon atlas for Mermaid Roshan, polished painted 2D storybook style matching the reference pearl wand's indigo contours, pearl highlights, brushed satin and gold filigree. A transparent 4 columns by 2 rows grid, eight large clearly separated complete icons, each centered in its cell, generous transparent padding, same apparent size. Overall sheet is wide 2:1. No letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, panels, scenery, floor or shadows. Row one left to right: 1 flowing lavender and coral ribbon with a small tail-fin clasp (Tidewing Ribbons); 2 luminous pearl nestled in a little lavender shell (Moonpearl charm); 3 turquoise spiral conch with warm gold mouth and flowing current marks (Swift Conch); 4 miniature pearl-and-rainbow star wand (Rainbow Wand). Row two left to right: 5 graceful living kelp loop with two rounded leaves and a gold clasp (Living Kelp); 6 soft peach scallop shell with a moon-shaped pearl and gentle lavender musical curl (Lullaby Shell); 7 friendly rounded purple tiny squid charm with a soft plume of purple ink (Twilight Squid); 8 a polished pale iridescent pearl coin with a gold rim, used as earned shop currency. Hand-painted objects, bold readable silhouettes, broad calm shading, no dangerous sharp points. Must belong to the established Mermaid Roshan reef.
